SR-009.justification: In a release build on the reference machine (Apple M4 Pro, 2026-11-02) explain answers a 4,000-byte path under agent_workspace v3 in under 1 ms on three targets (0.61 ms by the spawn bench), and diff_is_fast_on_large_policies diffs two 10,000-rule policies in under a second (about 0.05 s); debug builds run both cases without a bound.

SR-001.justification: Asks every expressible preset and the rule-kinds policy 1,277-1,278 questions per lane (macOS, Linux T1 and T2, run 2026-11-02), asserts at least 1,000, fails naming each disagreement, asserts every required rule kind is reached and that flipping any one kind's answers is detected; a non-gap cage error (AlreadySandboxed) panics in fitted().

SR-002.justification: classify() maps 0 to allowed, EACCES/EPERM/EROFS to denied and every other errno (ENOENT included) to Unresolved, which disagreements() counts as a failure; the kernel side is only the caged child's open and caged spawns, no sandbox_check.

SR-003.justification: The site page's table lists exactly MODELLED with "proven" for each of the three targets; explain_agrees_with_the_kernel asserts the asked operations equal MODELLED on every lane.

SR-004.justification: On T1 the rule-kinds policy asks writes under .git/hooks, .envrc and .vscode in a writable tree; the answers carry SPAWN_COVER ("T1 cover" is a required kind) and agree with the kernel; crates/procage-policy/tests/explain.rs::every_rule_kind_on_macos asserts a path is allowed by the grant with it bound and denied by the default without; the oracle binds the grant and agrees.

SR-005.justification: For every denied question of every preset and the kinds policy on three targets, applies the remedy, asserts the question becomes allowed, that an added rule is a literal for the asked path, and that the policy diff equals the remedy's diff; every_rule_kind_on_macos asserts the .git/hooks write is denied by trust-handoff with exactly that waiver.

SR-006.justification: Asserts /etc/hosts names /private/etc/hosts, /work/a/../b names /work/b and a relative path has no canonical form (unit test canonical_forms adds // . and trailing separators); pattern_characters_stay_literal asserts /work/a*[b is unaffected by a protect on /work/ab; oracle.rs::explain_follows_links asserts a link to a hidden file gets the hidden file's answer on all three lanes.

SR-007.justification: Asks metadata, unlink, network and signal operations under every preset on every target and asserts NotModelled with Decider::None.

SR-008.justification: For v3 presets and the kinds policy times 18 mutations (rules, base, every waiver, a grant) on three targets, every question whose answer differs is covered by an entry with the matching direction; one_more_writable_path_or_waiver, preset_versions_differ_only_in_their_base (base setting listed, entries from the base or build v2's sockets) and entries_are_tagged_with_their_target cover the other scenarios.

SR-010.justification: The page says an answer names the policy's rules and must not be relayed into the cage unfiltered; the crate docs (crates/procage-policy/src/explain/mod.rs module header) and both Cage::explain docs say the same.
